user.title: Connect to Hauflo
user.description: The pairing code is in Hauflo: project → «Deploy» → «Hauflo agent» → «Get a code». Then Hauflo deploys the project to this Home Assistant without an external address or token, and watches the site.

data.server: Hauflo address (only if your integrator says so)

reauth_confirm.title: Link the Hauflo agent again
reauth_confirm.description: Hauflo no longer knows this Home Assistant: the agent was unlinked or the project deleted. Get a new code in Hauflo (project → “Deploy” → “Hauflo agent” → “Get code”) — this entry is updated, no need to remove it.

data.server: Hauflo address (only if your integrator says so)

reconfigure.title: Link to another Hauflo project
reconfigure.description: Get a new code in Hauflo (project → «Deploy» → «Hauflo agent» → «Get a code»). This entry is updated; the agent's Home Assistant user stays.

data.server: Hauflo address (only if your integrator says so)

ranges.title: Group addresses for Hauflo
ranges.description: Hauflo will send commands only to these KNX group address ranges (main/middle) of project «{project}»: {ranges}. Remove any you don't want Hauflo to control (a gate, a lock). You can change this later in the integration's options.

error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or expired — get a new one in Hauflo.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Hauflo — check the address and the internet.
error.https_required: Hauflo's address must be https:// (http only for a local server).

abort.already_configured: Hauflo is already connected in this Home Assistant.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Hauflo agent per Home Assistant: it is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The Hauflo agent is linked again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Hauflo agent is linked with the new code.

init.title: Group addresses for Hauflo
init.description: Hauflo sends commands only to these ranges. Asked for and not allowed yet: {pending}.
